reset_last_performed.name: Reset Last Performed
reset_last_performed.description: Alias of Complete Task. A performed date applies to time intervals and calendar dates.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The ID of the task entity to reset.

performed_date.name: Performed Date
performed_date.description: Date the task was done. Used by time intervals and calendar dates.

complete_task.name: Complete Task
complete_task.description: Mark a task done. What resets depends on the due trigger. A performed date applies to time intervals and calendar dates.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The ID of the task entity to complete.

performed_date.name: Performed Date
performed_date.description: Date the task was done. Used by time intervals and calendar dates.

snooze_task.name: Snooze Task
snooze_task.description: Snooze or disable a maintenance task.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The ID of the task entity to snooze.

snooze_until.name: Snooze Until
snooze_until.description: Date when the task should auto-re-enable (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit to disable indefinitely.

disable.name: Disable
disable.description: If true, disable the task without a snooze date.

enable_task.name: Enable Task
enable_task.description: Re-enable a snoozed or disabled maintenance task.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The ID of the task entity to enable.

increment_counter.name: Increment Counter
increment_counter.description: Add one to a cycle-count task. Other due triggers ignore this.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The ID of the frequency task entity to increment.
